payload._note: Fortrea Holdings Inc. (ticker: _hsvc_Fortrea) is a global contract research organization (CRO) providing clinical development, patient access solutions and consulting to the life sciences industry. It is NOT a healthcare operator that owns or operates patient care facilities. The company provides clinical trial management, clinical pharmacology services, and clinical research services across ~90 countries with ~18,000 employees. The 10-K mentions 73 operating facilities in 39 countries (Item 2, Properties), but these are office and clinical research unit (CRU) facilities, NOT skilled nursing facilities, hospitals, or other Medicare-certified patient care facilities. The CRUs mentioned (Leeds UK - 100 beds, Dallas TX - 100 beds, Daytona FL - 72 beds, Madison WI - 72 beds) are Phase I clinical trial units for drug testing on healthy volunteers and patients, not healthcare provider facilities. These would not have Medicare CCNs as they are research facilities, not treatment facilities. Fortrea does not operate the types of facilities that would appear in CMS Provider of Services files or have Medicare Certification Numbers.
